Playlist.title: Playlist
Playlist.description: User custom or smart playlist containing track references and metadata

userId.description: The UID of the user who owns the playlist

colorHex.description: Hex color code for playlist card theming

trackIds.description: Ordered array of track identifiers in this playlist

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when playlist was created. Write with FieldValue.serverTimestamp()

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when playlist was last updated. Write with FieldValue.serverTimestamp()

UserSettings.title: UserSettings
UserSettings.description: User preferences including 5-band equalizer gains, DSP effects, visualizer and theme settings

equalizerBands.description: 5-band equalizer gain levels in millibels or dB levels (-10 to 10 dB)

activePreset.description: Active sound preset (e.g. Flat, Bass Boost, Vocal, Electronic, Rock)

volumeNormalization.description: Whether audio volume normalization is enabled

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when settings document was created

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when settings document was last updated

TrackItem.title: TrackItem
TrackItem.description: Cloud synced track metadata, play stats, and favorite flag

userId.description: The UID of the user owning this library track state

isFavorite.description: Whether the track is marked as favorite

playCount.description: Number of times this track has been played

lastPlayedAt.description: Server timestamp when track was last played

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when track was added to library

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when track record was last updated

/users/{userId}/playlists/{playlistId}.description: Playlists created and curated by the authenticated user

/users/{userId}/user_settings/{settingsI.description: Sound customizations, EQ profile, and interface theme per user

/users/{userId}/library_tracks/{trackId}.description: User library songs, favorites, and play counters
